items.title: Qwen2.5-Coder Series: Powerful, Diverse, Practical.
items.summary: GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE KAGGLE DEMO DISCORD Introduction Today, we are excited to open source the “Powerful”, “Diverse”, and “Practical” Qwen2.5-Coder series, dedicated to continuously promoting the development of Open CodeLLMs. Powerful: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct has become the current SOTA open-source code model, matching the coding capabilities of GPT-4o. items.summaryZh: 通义千问正式开源Qwen2.5-Coder系列代码大模型，包含多个尺寸。其中的Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct表现卓越，在代码生成、修复等任务上达到了当前开源代码大模型的SOTA水平，其编程能力可比肩GPT-4o，同时兼具通用和数学能力。
